messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Hey team — need to lock the staging cutover slot with CloudStore for the marketplace listing. They proposed Tue 03/30 02:00-04:00 UTC. We need press timing, landing page publish, and SI integration smoke tests. Who can own approvals and the fallback if that slot slips? @Liam (Marketing) @Sarah (Product) @Diego (Ops)

Liam (Marketing): I can own press + embargo. Quick Q — does the partner require a specific embargo window?

Anna (Partnerships): They want a 24h embargo + partner review 48h before publish. So draft needs to be ready by Sun 03/28 02:00 UTC.

Sarah (Product): Landing page can be ready, but need asset handoff from partner (logo + 2 screenshots) and final copy from Liam. ETA for our staging push is Mon 03/29 18:00 UTC.

Diego (Ops): The 02:00-04:00 UTC window works for minimal traffic. Ops note: we'll need DB read-only for ~10m and an iam migration for the new catalog flags. Suggest we do a small preflight at 01:30.

Jen (Sales): Also flagging SI partners — they want a pre-roll demo at +4 hours post-cutover. Can we confirm feature flags will be on for dedicated SI tenants?

Liam (Marketing): I'll draft the press memo. Sharing doc: https://docs.google.com/draft/marketplace-cloudstore-draft (please add comments). Will need partner legal + PR signoff by Sun 03/28 08:00 UTC.

press-bot: Reminder: embargo policy — all external PR must have a signed embargo agreement and final assets 24h before publish. Checklist: draft, partner approval, legal OK, image alt text.

Sarah (Product): Quick checklist (copying here):
```
- Feature flags enabled for SI tenants (owner: Sarah)
- Landing page staging URL created (owner: Sarah)
- Partner assets delivered (owner: Anna)
- Smoke tests for API + auth (owner: Diego)
- Analytics event mapping (owner: Product Analytics)
```

Diego (Ops): Ops runbook snippet for cutover:
```
- 01:20 UTC: deploy staging build to canary
- 01:30 UTC: small preflight smoke tests (auth, list, generate)
- 01:50 UTC: scale down old workers (if needed)
- 02:00 UTC: DB read-only for 10m, flip catalog flag
- 02:10 UTC: run full smoke tests; rollback window 02:30-03:00 UTC
- 03:00 UTC: verify metrics and open write access
```

Anna (Partnerships): Fallback plan if CloudStore delays: propose fallback slot Thu 04/01 02:00-04:00 UTC or fall back to a limited announcement (partner quote + blog) without marketplace tile. Who owns the limited-announcement assets?

Liam (Marketing): We can do a limited announcement. I'll prepare a short blog + partner quote template. If we fallback, blog goes live +1h after cutover attempt. Need approvals earlier though.

Jen (Sales): I'll coordinate SI demo timing and notify partners of both primary and fallback windows. Also looping in partner PM to confirm asset delivery: @Anna please ping their PM for logos/screenshots.

Anna (Partnerships): Pinged partner PM (CloudStore: @maya_cloud). Maya says logos ready, screenshots arriving EOD Fri. She asked about a sandbox push for SI partners — we should sync on API keys.

Diego (Ops): For SI sandbox keys — we can generate temporary keys and expire after 48h. Will prepare a short script for rotation.

Liam (Marketing): Action items from this thread for clarity:
- Liam: press draft + embargo doc (due Sun 03/28 02:00 UTC)
- Anna: confirm partner assets + PM liaison (logos + screenshots)
- Sarah: landing page staging + analytics mapping (staging push Mon 03/29 18:00 UTC)
- Diego: ops runbook + sandbox key rotation script
- Jen: SI demo scheduling and partner comms

Anna (Partnerships): Can everyone drop an ack here if they agree with owners and timings? Would like final go/no-go by Mon 03/29 12:00 UTC.

Liam (Marketing): ACK — will post draft by Sat EOD for early review. :thumbsup:

Sarah (Product): ACK — landing staging on track.

Diego (Ops): ACK — prepping runbook and will do preflight at 01:30.

Jen (Sales): ACK — coordinating SI partners and will confirm demo list by Mon 03/29 09:00 UTC.

press-bot: Scheduled reminder set for Sun 03/28 08:00 UTC to gather partner legal signoff.

Anna (Partnerships): Thanks all — I'll schedule a quick 20m sync Mon 03/29 13:00 UTC to confirm final go/no-go. If anything changes ping here or DM me. :raised_hands:
